description: This Dart source file implements a Service Locator pattern for managing service instances such as authentication, product, cart, and order services in a Flutter project. It initializes these services with shared preferences and an API client, providing a centralized point for service management.

classes.name: ServiceLocator
classes.description: A class that provides static access to various services used throughout the application, initializing them asynchronously.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes all service instances by setting up the API client and shared preferences, with logging and error handling.
